description: OpenCode config keys managed by Riggverk install/health. User provider blocks, non-playwright MCP servers and agent entries other than the listed ones are preserved. agent_permissions: built-in agents whose agent.<name>.permission block is managed. subagent_model_roles: bundled subagents whose agent.<role>.model is managed while a subagent model override is set, and removed when it is cleared; nothing else under agent.<role> is managed. tui_top_level: the top-level keys of tui.json the app manages; every other key of that file is the user's.
